en.name: Tianyu Lu
en.headline: Bioinformatician · Collaborative Sequencing Analysis
en.affiliation: Department of Microbiology / Sequencing Core, University of Pennsylvania · Philadelphia
en.summary: Bioinformatics analysis for collaborative studies in HIV, viral integration, single-cell multiomics, and spatial transcriptomics.
about_paragraphs: I am a bioinformatician supporting sequencing studies across research labs and collaborative teams. I work with investigators to translate biological questions and experimental designs into rigorous analysis plans, reproducible workflows, and results that can be interpreted and communicated.

At the University of Pennsylvania, my primary focus is data analysis for HIV research, viral integration-site analysis, and single-cell sequencing, including multimodal assays and spatial transcriptomics. I take projects from raw sequencing data through quality control, alignment or quantification, data integration, statistical analysis, visualization, and collaborator-facing reporting.

My background also includes machine learning in computational biology. In the Pfenning Lab at Carnegie Mellon University, I combined deep learning, comparative genomics, and phylogenetic statistics to study the evolution of mammalian traits using regulatory-sequence models.
en.research_intro: Sequencing analysis, statistical methods, and reproducible workflows for biomedical research.

experience_entries.title: Bioinformatician
experience_entries.org: University of Pennsylvania · Department of Microbiology / Sequencing Core
experience_entries.summary: Develop computational pipelines for sequencing datasets: data ingestion and quality control, sample assignment, alignment and annotation, statistical comparisons, and automated reporting.
bullets: Develop R, Python, and Bash workflows spanning raw-read processing, count matrices, metadata joins, quality control, and visualization for research teams at Penn Medicine, CHOP, and the Penn Center for AIDS Research.
Build single-cell and multiomic analyses with normalization, batch correction, clustering, annotation, differential expression, and pathway and cell-composition analysis.
Process short- and long-read sequence data using alignment filters, barcode extraction, junction checks, genomic annotation, and read aggregation into integration-site summaries.
Analyze spatial expression data using region-of-interest definitions, cell-type and region annotation, visualization, and paired-sample comparisons.
Adapt transcriptomic statistical models to paired and multi-group designs; summarize gene-level changes and pathway-level patterns.
Deploy workflows on Linux, Slurm, and AWS, using Git, Docker, and automation scripts for repeatability and batch processing. Communicate assumptions and results to experimental collaborators.

experience_entries.title: Research Assistant
experience_entries.summary: Trained convolutional neural networks on regulatory sequences and predicted enhancer activity across 224 mammalian species, combining machine learning with phylogenetic hypothesis testing.
bullets: Combined comparative genomics and deep learning to model cell-type-specific enhancer activity from sequence.
Trained convolutional neural networks using putamen-neuron enhancer sequences to investigate conserved and convergent sequence patterns.

Predicted activity across 224 mammalian species and evaluated associations with sleep duration, maximum lifespan, and vocal learning using phylogenetic permutation tests and multiple-testing correction.
Automated data preprocessing, model training and prediction, statistical testing, and result summaries.

zh.name: 鲁天宇
zh.tagline: 生物信息学与科学计算
zh.headline: 生物信息学分析师 · 协作型测序分析
zh.affiliation: 宾夕法尼亚大学 微生物学系 / 测序核心平台 · 费城
zh.summary: 为合作型研究提供生物信息学分析，聚焦 HIV、病毒整合位点、单细胞多组学与空间转录组。
about_paragraphs: 我是一名生物信息学分析师，主要为不同实验室和合作团队的测序研究提供数据分析支持。我与研究人员协作，将生物学问题和实验设计转化为严谨的分析方案、可复现流程，以及便于解释和交流的结果。
目前在宾夕法尼亚大学，我的工作重点包括 HIV 研究、病毒整合位点分析及单细胞测序，其中涵盖多模态组学与空间转录组。我负责从原始测序数据出发，完成质量控制、比对或定量、数据整合、统计分析、可视化及面向合作者的结果汇报。
我的背景还包括计算生物学中的机器学习研究。在卡内基梅隆大学 Pfenning 实验室，我结合深度学习、比较基因组学和系统发育统计，利用调控序列模型研究哺乳动物性状的演化。
zh.research_intro: 面向生物医学研究的测序分析、统计方法与可复现流程。
